proposed_work: Strict immutable scalar helper contracts, including identity/clock/completeness/Fraction guards.
Versioned RollPolicy and immutable selection evidence vector; predecessor-session identity/interval and instrument lifetime checks.
Separately named known-time fixed/provider-map records alongside prior-volume comparator.
Explicit paired quote/bridge policy with age/skew/eligibility, exact point/tick coordinates and uncertainty.
One-time reset/translation records for price levels, bands and bounded profile nodes; declared state-invariant dispatch.
Separate point-in-time split and cash-dividend actions/coordinates, with no automatic F02 deliverable inference.
Small bounded RollLedger using existing Journal append/restore semantics for F08 records; reject conflicting IDs, configuration changes and capacity overflow.
constraints: Retain existing same-cut arithmetic expectations and prior-volume tie behavior.
Do not edit data/definitions.py or instrument/payoff registry except a separately reviewed minimum integration need.
Legacy bridge helper lacking an explicit age policy cannot authorize indefinite later-cut reuse.
Any real parent-completeness certificate remains external evidence, never inferred by a synthetic flag.

Independent profile mass/level transition and split/dividend cash examples.
Independent direct raw-contract fill/cost arithmetic; no implementation selector/translation method used as oracle.
constraints: No source archive, market tape or dynamic expected-value derivation from the implementation.
Reference is bounded finite engineering algebra, not a market replay or model.

Finite profile, option-coordinate gate and raw-fill consumer integration; measured toy operations/resources only where useful.

Existing test_rolls_definitions.py expectations remain intact; extend coverage without weakening them.

data_contracts.name: RollPolicy
data_contracts.contract: Frozen policy identity/name, predecessor-session and tie rules, optional fixed/provider mapping identity; no fit or realized-return selection.

data_contracts.name: SelectionEvidence
data_contracts.contract: Decision cut, input_known_at and actual_completion_at/output_known_at kept separate; universe scope/full version, every considered definition/volume/exclusion evidence with namespace/lifetime, typed calendar predecessor evidence, selected identity and policy version. Same-valued new lineage changes version. Scalar reference remains unpublished.

data_contracts.name: RawCoordinate / PriceObservation
data_contracts.contract: Exact provider/venue/lifetime/raw-contract and point/tick domain; price Fraction, Clocks, quote eligibility, version and observation time. No bare root coordinate substitution.

data_contracts.name: BridgePolicy / RollBridge
data_contracts.contract: Frozen maximum skew/age, paired observation span and versions, exact additive point spread and uncertainty; cut-aware availability. No hidden widening of source uncertainty or backdating.

data_contracts.name: CoordinateState / TransitionRecord
data_contracts.contract: Source state ID/version/coordinate, parent lineage, explicit reset/translate/carry mode, target coordinate, bridge/action/policy version, destination version, original clocks, error and exposure/cost lineage. Bounded profile nodes.

data_contracts.name: SplitAction / DividendAction
data_contracts.contract: Action kind, asset lifetime, effect and known times, exact ratio or per-share cash/currency, original evidence and supersedes identity; split and dividend are separate domains.

data_contracts.name: RollLedger
data_contracts.contract: Journal-backed append-only F08 evidence namespace with immutable registration/configuration identity and explicit retained record/byte/profile/chain bounds; restored state validates every envelope and preserves source clocks.

consumer_proposal.name: selection parity gate
consumer_proposal.input: Declared book/trade/bar raw coordinate plus versioned selection
consumer_proposal.expected: Same outright rule/coordinate accepted; mismatch blocks dependent comparison. No actual dataset read.
consumer_proposal.scope: Finite F08 consumer adapter, not whole F05/F06 admission.

consumer_proposal.name: price band/profile consumer
consumer_proposal.input: Bounded source nodes and source object version plus bridge/reset choice
consumer_proposal.expected: Exact transformed coordinates, conserved contracts, one transition only, retained source/destination lineage and off-grid status.
consumer_proposal.scope: Finite state consumer; no claim all F10 lifecycle generators are integrated.

consumer_proposal.name: point-scale/price-anchor consumer
consumer_proposal.input: Explicit invariant declaration and typed source state
consumer_proposal.expected: Additive shift preserves point-scale, shifts price anchor, unknown invariant resets/rejects.
consumer_proposal.scope: Two demonstrable algebraic invariants, not an arbitrary indicator state transplant.

consumer_proposal.name: raw option coordinate gate
consumer_proposal.input: Typed raw or adjusted/display/total-return underlying coordinate
consumer_proposal.expected: Only compatible raw option coordinate admitted; unknown adjusted deliverable remains F02-unavailable.
consumer_proposal.scope: Coordinate guard, not an options pricing model or native contract adapter.

consumer_proposal.name: raw fill/accounting fixture
consumer_proposal.input: Two exact raw-contract legs, one contract, multiplier and explicit side fees
consumer_proposal.expected: 20+40=60 gross,8 fees,52 net; chart adjustment has no cash effect.
consumer_proposal.scope: Synthetic exact accounting integration, not observed performance or execution simulation.

consumer_proposal.name: E0 completeness consumer
consumer_proposal.input: Existing cohort required checks and retained dependency metadata
consumer_proposal.expected: Missing complete-parent/prior-session evidence keeps exact E0 non-runnable; acquired diagnostic scope cannot satisfy exact scope.
consumer_proposal.scope: Preserve existing gate and dependency; no market cohort construction.

comparison_stages: Source-faithful documented provider/calendar/raw-coordinate comparator, including explicit unavailable cases.
Corrected prior-completed-session selection and causal reset/translation reference.
Versioned bridge/action/state-transfer kernel versus independent literal reference on exactly the same finite inputs.
registration_sequence: Root freezes protocol/golden and registers F08 family; root owns ports.py/verify.py. F08 may have its own registered family while sharing one combined measured F05-F08 suite.
Root authorizes bounded source/tests implementation in owned files.
One complete static review of all new code and affected callers; collect the full batch.
One consolidated repair, then root performs the registered combined supervised full-suite verification.
Preserve failed attempts and snapshot/report/resource evidence; no separate unaccounted F08 run.
